🚨 BREAKING NEWS!

The Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR) has detected 2 cases of the HMPV (Human Meta pneumovirus) in Bengaluru. This comes after an 8-month-old baby was previously confirmed with the virus in the city.

Stay vigilant
